apps.localizedDescription:
Absorb:

A modern audiobookshelf client with a card-based player experience.

A note on AI: Absorb is developed by a human with AI assistance (mostly Claude Code) helping write, refactor, and review code. It's not "vibe coded" or auto-generated, every change is reviewed, tested, and shipped intentionally. That said, I'm all in on AI as a development tool. It massively speeds up the work and lets a solo developer ship features and fixes at a pace that wouldn't be possible otherwise. I'm sharing this openly so you know what's behind the app.

Features:

• Card-based player — full-screen "Absorbing" cards replace the traditional player screen.
• Audiobookshelf integration — connects to your self-hosted audiobookshelf server.

• Podcast support — chaptered podcasts with rich HTML descriptions.

versions.localizedDescription:
Read along:

• New - Read along: the narration is highlighted in the ebook as the audiobook plays, word by word or a sentence at a time, and the pages turn themselves. Turn pages freely and tap Back to narration to return.
• New - Live transcript on the card for podcasts and books without an ebook, on streamed books too.

Ebook reader:

• New - Scroll mode, left-aligned text, and an option to keep the title bar on screen.
• New - Picture-only ebooks open in the comic reader, which now has bookmarks.
• New - The reader's player opens chapters, sleep timer, bookmarks, equalizer, cast and more.

• Fix - Books open where you left off after reading on the web or in another app.

BookOrbit:

• New - Sign in to BookOrbit servers, including SSO and magic links.

• New - Filter the library by reading status.

Playback:

• New - Speed up to 5x, and on Android the loudness boost really raises the volume.
• New - Choose what the notification, lock screen, Android Auto and CarPlay show on each line.
• New - Keep the screen on in the player and car mode.

• Fix - Play picks up the newer spot from another device, and progress that fails to send is kept and sent later.

Queue and series:

• New - Adding to Absorbing asks whether it plays next or goes to the end.
• New - The series sheet opens on the covers around your next book, with series stats and an up next button.
• Fix - The series queue plays the actual next book and works past book 100.

Car:

• New - Car settings with sort options, and Collections and Playlists in the car library.
• Fix - Android Auto no longer restarts the book when you switch to the radio.

Library:

• New - New Collection and New Playlist buttons in the Lists tab, and search across bookmarks and highlights.
• New - Sort series by total duration or last book added, and upload files into an existing book.
• New - Find the start in the chapter editor listens around a marker for where the chapter really begins.

Sign-in:

• Improved - SSO sign-in returns to absorb://oauth. Server admins need to allow it under Settings, Authentication, Mobile redirect URIs (#417).

Other:

• Fix - Book details use each library's cover shape and show every genre and tag, and authors without a photo no longer trip fail2ban (#418).
• Fix - Settings sync no longer wakes the phone every 45 seconds in the background (#409).
